en.title: US-Iran Peace Deal Imminent
en.summary: The probability for a US-Iran permanent peace deal by June 15, 2026, surged to 98% following widespread reports of an agreement. Multiple news outlets confirmed a deal was announced, with Reuters specifically stating a signing is set for Friday, June 15.
drivers: Reuters: US, Iran reach peace deal, signing set for Friday.
Multiple US media announce deal to end war.
President Trump involved in deal announcement.
en.why_matters: This historic agreement could fundamentally reshape Middle East geopolitics, fostering regional stability and potentially impacting global energy markets.
en.bull_case: The reported signing of the peace deal on June 15, 2026, will confirm the market outcome, pushing probability to 100%.
en.bear_case: A last-minute unforeseen political or logistical obstacle could prevent the official signing by the June 15 deadline.

zh.bull_case: 2026年6月15日和平协议的签署将确认市场结果，推动概率升至100%。
zh.bear_case: 最后一刻的政治或物流障碍可能阻止在6月15日截止日期前正式签署。

en.title: Iran Deal Prospects Rise
en.summary: The probability of Iran agreeing to end uranium enrichment by December 31 rose to 56% following reports of a draft U.S. deal offering sanctions relief and asset release. An Iranian official also confirmed they would not acquire nuclear weapons ahead of a potential signing.
drivers: Draft U.S. deal offers Iran sanctions relief (Reuters)
Iran official confirms no nuclear weapons (Jerusalem Post)
U.S. defers nuclear questions, pulls back on war (NYT)
en.why_matters: A deal could de-escalate regional tensions, prevent nuclear proliferation, and potentially stabilize global oil markets by bringing Iranian oil back.
en.bull_case: A comprehensive draft deal with significant concessions for Iran makes an agreement highly probable by year-end.
en.bear_case: Iran's continued uranium fortification or last-minute disagreements could derail the fragile diplomatic efforts.

drivers: 美国协议草案向伊朗提供制裁减免 (路透社)

zh.bull_case: 包含重大让步的全面协议草案使伊朗在年底前达成协议的可能性大增。
zh.bear_case: 伊朗持续浓缩铀或最后一刻的分歧可能导致脆弱的外交努力失败。

en.title: Anthropic IPO Hopes Surge Amid AI Boom
en.summary: The probability of Anthropic IPOing by October 31, 2026, jumped 11.5% to 58%, primarily driven by widespread reports of an impending tech and AI IPO wave. CNBC and WSJ headlines highlighted a favorable market environment for AI companies seeking public offerings.
drivers: CNBC reported an 'AI, SpaceX and the IPO boom'.
WSJ highlighted 'Tech’s Next IPO Wave'.
OKX's Haider Rafique discussed pre-IPO perpetuals, signaling market readiness.
en.why_matters: Anthropic's potential IPO is a key indicator of investor appetite for advanced AI companies and could set a precedent for future valuations in the sector. Its public debut would offer a significant liquidity event for early investors and employees.
en.bull_case: Strong market appetite for AI IPOs and a general tech IPO wave, as reported by CNBC and WSJ, will push Anthropic to capitalize on favorable conditions.
en.bear_case: Regulatory hurdles, like the US government order to shut down Fable 5 and Mythos 5, could delay or complicate Anthropic's IPO plans.

zh.title: Anthropic IPO预期因AI热潮飙升
zh.summary: Anthropic在2026年10月31日前IPO的可能性上升了11.5%至58%，主要受关于科技和AI IPO浪潮即将到来的广泛报道推动。CNBC和《华尔街日报》的头条新闻强调了AI公司上市的有利市场环境。
drivers: CNBC报道了“AI、SpaceX和IPO热潮”。
《华尔街日报》强调“科技的下一波IPO”。
OKX的Haider Rafique讨论了IPO前永续合约，预示市场准备就绪。
zh.why_matters: Anthropic的潜在IPO是衡量投资者对先进AI公司兴趣的关键指标，并可能为该领域的未来估值树立先例。其上市将为早期投资者和员工提供重要的流动性事件。
zh.bull_case: CNBC和《华尔街日报》报道的AI IPO强劲市场需求和科技IPO浪潮将促使Anthropic抓住有利时机。
zh.bear_case: 美国政府命令Anthropic关闭Fable 5和Mythos 5等监管障碍，可能推迟或复杂化其IPO计划。
